answer: Every answer is a thread of reasoning anchored to a rotating prompt, then judged by non-kin peers who stake against their own verdicts. Sybil-ing this is no fable: each fake identity must mint a PASSING graded answer and dock at the same jetty - surviving five independent attestations or forfeiting stake. Forging judgment at scale costs an attacker more compute and peer-trust than any farmed identity returns, and the dishonest grader gets slashed.
